Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Five Party Finder categories that could not be posted at all now can: Deep Dungeons, Treasure Hunt, FATEs, PvP and Duty Roulette. Each used to put a listing up with the wrong duty attached or with none, and three of them were offering names the game's own recruitment window has never had - deep dungeons were listed per floor set, treasure hunts as the dungeons a map opens into. They are listed the way the game lists them now, and a preset for one posts as that duty. Treasure hunts are also always limited to your own world, the way FATEs and hunt trains are, because the dig only happens on the world it was started on. Party Finder can also show you what a locked duty actually is, if you turn it on in Settings - listings the game labels "Locked Duty" get the fight's real name back, still marked so you can tell you cannot join. A prompt now dims and holds the whole plugin rather than one window, and the dimming behind it appears at all, which it never had.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: AutoRezzer
Description:
A quick, handy tool for handling raises - both casting them and accepting them.

One switch. While it is on, any raisable body in range gets raised on whatever job you are on that can do it, Swiftcast first when it is up, and Red Mage going through Vercure for an instant Verraise. Bodies with a raise already on them are left alone, and nothing is cast on a corpse with enemies standing on it. The other half accepts raises cast on you, so you are not the one lying there waiting on a menu.

Built mostly for Occult Crescent and FATEs, where people go down constantly and nobody is tracking who still needs picking up.
Punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
